h1: Immersion heater and cylinder thermostat help
title: Immersion Heater & Thermostat Help London | Cylinder Faults
description: Discuss immersion heater and cylinder thermostat help. Diagnosis-led support, clear scope and postcode-based availability. Call 020 7205 4433.
answer: A heating failure may involve a supply, timer, immersion, thermostat or cut-out; electrical and cylinder competence must match the job.

sections.heading: What the service addresses
paragraphs: If an off-peak heater fails but boost still works, the fault is not necessarily the whole cylinder. On applicable systems, separate supplies, heater positions and timing arrangements can explain different behaviour. Share which normal control was used and whether a consumer-unit device has tripped.

sections.heading: Planning the visit
paragraphs: Internal wiring, resistance testing and cut-out resets are not homeowner checks. Repeated operation of a protective device can indicate a fault requiring investigation. Do not repeatedly reset an RCD or bypass a thermal cut-out to restore hot water.

sections.heading: Clear scope and practical next steps
paragraphs: A replacement element or control needs to suit the actual cylinder and electrical arrangement. G3 positioning alone does not establish every electrical qualification; the work should be assigned to a suitably competent person and tested appropriately.

sections.heading: Arrange an enquiry
paragraphs: Contact 020 7205 4433 with your postcode, equipment make and model, symptoms and access details. The enquiry is used to establish the appropriate work and appointment availability. Costs and scope are discussed before agreed work.

faqs.question: Does boost working prove that the off-peak immersion is healthy?
faqs.answer: No. Boost and off-peak operation may use different heaters, controls or supplies; a competent person must identify the failed path.
